title: probe image input
explanation:
### Description

Probe a wavelet image through a Delaunay-triangulated point cloud and render the result using ray-cast volume rendering.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkColorTransferFunction](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkColorTransferFunction.html) — maps scalar values to RGB colors for volume rendering.
- [vtkDelaunay3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDelaunay3D.html) — creates a 3D Delaunay triangulation from a point set.
- [vtkFloatArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFloatArray.html) — stores an array of floating-point values.
- [vtkImageData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageData.html) — represents a regular grid of points (image/volume).
- [vtkMath](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMath.html) — provides mathematical utility functions.
- [vtkPiecewiseFunction](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPiecewiseFunction.html) — defines a piecewise linear scalar-to-opacity mapping.
- [vtkPointSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPointSource.html) — generates random points inside a sphere.
- [vtkProbeFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkProbeFilter.html) — samples source data at the point locations of the input.
- [vtkRTAnalyticSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRTAnalyticSource.html) — generates a synthetic wavelet image volume.
- [vtkSmartVolumeMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSmartVolumeMapper.html) — selects the best volume rendering strategy automatically.
- [vtkVolume](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVolume.html) — represents a volume in the scene.
- [vtkVolumeProperty](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVolumeProperty.html) — controls volume rendering appearance (color, opacity, shading).
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
